title: TOEIC 每日練習 Day 22（2026-11-19）
summary: 最新成績仍是 Day 15 的 15/25（Day 16 之後還沒交卷）。今天繼續加強兩大弱點：consider／keep／find + 受詞 + 形容詞（3 題，含 remarkably easy 副詞對照），以及閱讀、聽力的「時間細節干擾」（新舊日期與時間混在選項裡）。另外複習 if 子句配 will／would、Despite／Although 對照、comply with、whose／who、be responsible for、on + 日期。聽力今天是 Part 4 電話留言。做完按「交卷」就會自動回傳成績

sections.heading: Part 5 文法與字彙（建議 11 分鐘）
sections.tip: find／keep／leave／make + 受詞 + 空格：描述受詞用形容詞；空格後面若還有形容詞，空格就是副詞。假設語氣先看主要子句：will 配 if 現在式，would 配 if 過去式。Although 接句子，In spite of／Despite 接名詞。

qs.stem: If the weather ------- good tomorrow, the company picnic will be held in the park.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 主要子句 will be held ＝ 真實可能發生。2. if 子句用現在式，the weather 單數用 is。3. 選 A。C were 要配 would。

qs.stem: If we ------- a bigger budget, we could hire two more engineers.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 主要子句 could hire ＝ 與現在事實相反（其實預算不夠）。2. if 子句用過去式 had。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: The manager considers the new proposal ------- for next year's plan.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. consider + 受詞（the new proposal）+ 空格。2. 描述受詞「有用的」用形容詞 useful。3. 選 A。consider 和 find／keep／make 是同一個句型，受詞後面接形容詞，不是副詞。

qs.stem: Please keep the storage room door ------- at all times.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. keep + 受詞（the door）+ 空格，描述門的狀態。2. 門是「被關上的」，用過去分詞當形容詞 closed。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: Customers found the online form ------- easy to complete.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. find + 受詞（the online form）+ 空格 + easy。2. 空格後面已經有形容詞 easy，空格是修飾 easy，用副詞 remarkably。3. 選 B。口訣：空格後還有形容詞 → 副詞；沒有 → 形容詞。

qs.stem: ------- the heavy traffic, most employees arrived on time.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後 the heavy traffic 是名詞片語，沒有動詞。2. 讓步「儘管」又接名詞，用介系詞 Despite。3. 選 A。Although 是連接詞，要接句子。

qs.stem: ------- the store opened late, it still had a record number of customers.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後 the store opened late 有主詞＋動詞，是完整句子。2. 讓步接句子用連接詞 Although。3. 選 C。對照上一題：接名詞用 Despite，接句子用 Although。

qs.stem: All suppliers are required to comply ------- our quality standards.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. comply with ＝ 遵守，固定搭配。2. 選 C。這題已考過多次，看到 comply 直接選 with。

qs.stem: The company is looking for an assistant ------- main task will be to manage schedules.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後先出現名詞 main task，再接動詞 will be。2. 「那位助理『的』主要工作」。3. 選 whose。

qs.stem: Mr. Patel, ------- joined the firm last month, has already won two clients.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後直接接動詞 joined，缺主詞。2. Mr. Patel 是人，用 who。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: Ms. Chen is responsible ------- training all new staff members.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. be responsible for ＝ 負責，固定搭配。2. 選 C。對照：be in charge of 用 of。

qs.stem: The annual report must be submitted ------- Friday, November 27.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 星期幾、日期用 on。2. 時刻用 at；月份、年份用 in。3. 選 C。

sections.heading: Part 7 短篇閱讀（建議 9 分鐘）
sections.tip: 先讀題目、圈關鍵字（mainly、What time、Where、NOT），再回原文找那一句。看到 A instead of B，A 是新的、B 是舊的。NOT 題四個選項都要回原文打勾。
passage: To: All Staff  From: Linda Park, Office Manager  Subject: Change to Fire Drill Schedule
The fire drill planned for Tuesday, November 24, has been moved to Thursday, November 26, because the building inspector is not available earlier in the week.

The drill will now begin at 2:00 P.M. instead of 10:30 A.M. and should take about 20 minutes. When the alarm sounds, please leave by the east stairs and meet in the north parking lot, not at the front entrance as before.
Visitors in the building at that time should be guided outside by the staff member they are meeting. Thank you for your cooperation.

qs.stem: Why did Ms. Park send the e-mail?
opts: To announce a new office manager
To explain a change to a fire drill
To report a problem with the stairs
To invite staff to a safety class
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 目的題看主旨和第一句：Change to Fire Drill Schedule、has been moved。2. 選 B。

qs.stem: When will the fire drill begin?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. moved to Thursday（新日期），begin at 2:00 P.M. instead of 10:30 A.M.（instead of 後面是舊時間）。2. 新日期＋新時間 → 選 D。A、B、C 都混了舊資訊，是時間細節干擾。

qs.stem: Where should employees meet during the drill?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 找 meet：meet in the north parking lot, not at the front entrance as before。2. 選 B。A 是「以前」的地點陷阱；C east stairs 是離開的路線，不是集合點。

qs.stem: What is NOT mentioned about the fire drill?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：NOT 題逐一打勾。A：about 20 minutes，有。B：inspector is not available，有。C：沒說誰帶領，選 C。D：Visitors…should be guided outside，有。

sections.heading: Part 2 聽力應答（建議 6 分鐘）
sections.tip: 先聽清楚第一個字（Why don't we／or／What time／Didn't／Who／How often）。Why don't we 是建議，不選 Because；A or B 問句不選 Yes。重複題目的字或發音相近的字通常是陷阱。

qs.stem: Why don't we order lunch for the team?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Why don't we…? ＝ 建議「我們何不……」。2. B「好啊，我來打給餐廳」接受建議。3. A 是 Because 陷阱；C 重複 order。

qs.stem: Would you like coffee or tea?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. A or B 選擇疑問句，先刪 Yes 開頭。2. B 直接選 tea。3. C 答非所問。

qs.stem: What time does the store close today?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. What time 問時間。2. A「七點」。3. B 回答地點；C 用 close／clothes 發音相近陷阱。

qs.stem: Didn't Mr. Lee already sign the contract?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 把 not 拿掉：Did Mr. Lee sign the contract?。2. A「還沒，他還在看」。3. B 用 sign（招牌）同字異義；C 用 contact／contract 相近字陷阱。

qs.stem: Who will lead tomorrow's training session?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Who 問人。2. B「人資部的人」。3. A 是 Yes 陷阱，且重複 tomorrow；C 回答地點。

qs.stem: How often do you visit the factory?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. How often 問頻率。2. A「大約一個月兩次」。3. B 回答 How（交通方式）；C 重複 factory。

sections.heading: Part 4 電話留言（建議 4 分鐘）
sections.tip: 播放前先讀三題，圈出 Why、When、offer。時間題會出現好幾個時間（原本的、新的、回電期限），要聽 now…instead 那個新的。offer 題常換句話說：ten percent off ＝ discount。
script: Hi, this is Karen Wu from Bright Office Supplies. I'm calling about your order of printer paper and ink.
We planned to deliver it this Wednesday morning, but our truck needs repairs. The order will now arrive on Friday afternoon, around four o'clock, instead.
Because of the delay, we will take ten percent off your bill. If Friday doesn't work for you, please call me back at 555-0147 before Thursday noon.

qs.stem: Why is the speaker calling?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 聽開頭和第二句：calling about your order…will now arrive on Friday。2. 選 B。

qs.stem: When will the order most likely arrive?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 時間題要聽「最後確定」的：will now arrive on Friday afternoon, around four o'clock, instead。2. Wednesday 是原本時間，Thursday noon 是回電期限，都是干擾。3. 選 C。

qs.stem: What does the speaker offer?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. offer 題聽 we will…：we will take ten percent off your bill（打九折）。2. ten percent off ＝ a discount，換句話說。3. 選 B。
